Here's the FigDown document. Note: I only have the genre-independent core spec you supplied (the `block` genre details live in `reference/scene.md` / `reference/layout.md`, which weren't included), so I used the plain, minimal node/edge syntax implied by the skeleton's own conventions. Please run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js telemetry-export-pipeline.fd` to validate against the actual `scene.md` grammar and fix any line errors it reports.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Telemetry export pipeline"

block poller "Poller"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block healthprobe "Health probe"
block buffer "Ring buffer"
block exporter "Exporter"

edge poller -> normalizer
edge healthprobe -> normalizer
edge normalizer -> buffer
edge buffer -> exporter
```

Structure captured, matching only what the description states (no timing, buffer capacity, or protocol details invented):

- **poller** → **normalizer**: raw samples collected from the device on a timer
- **healthprobe** → **normalizer**: independent device status ping, feeding the same normalizer
- **normalizer** → **buffer**: normalized samples enter the ring buffer
- **buffer** → **exporter**: exporter drains the buffer and ships to a remote collector

The "remote collector" itself isn't drawn as a node since the description places it outside this internal pipeline (the exporter "ships to" it, not a component being wired here) — flag this if you'd rather it appear as a sixth block.
